decisive_finding.issue: A canonical request-shaped but forged reuse artifact is authenticated only after a durable reuse reservation has inserted a consumed grant and published a new ledger generation.
evidence: The mediator preflight checks canonical shape, state, protocol, and intent but not the completed-record witness.
The production issuer passes structurally valid forged bytes into ledger reservation.
The ledger inserts the consumed grant before the mediator discovers the forged witness.
Existing focused reuse tests pass while accepting an IncompleteExecution result and checking only that protocol state remains Complete.
decisive_finding.impact: Repeated forged artifacts can exhaust the 16384-grant ceiling and deny later exact reuse even though the Complete protocol record is not regressed.
decisive_finding.required_fix: Authenticate canonical supplied reuse read-only against the exact current Complete ledger record before reservation, then CAS-bind any later reservation to that authenticated record. Refusal must preserve exact durable bytes, cardinalities, workspace tree, and status while later exact reuse remains accepted.

review_limits: Review stopped at the first material behavioral defect. Full dependency closure and remaining capacity, recovery, and CAS behavior were not independently accepted.
claim_ceiling: REWORK; source-local routine production authority is not accepted.
no_claim_statement: No claim of integration, public routine behavior, installation, runtime behavior, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
